title: The storage panel: drive use, the sets that fit under the target, and what they are worth
caption: The lab volume's and the owner's home's use as spine-datasets' feed read them, every set the feed knows with its size, licence, state, level truth, people with level truth per terabyte, regions and uses, and the choices (keep, remove, add, place on the lab or the home) that build a selection the planner's check admits under the target; what the kept sets are worth (people with level truth by modality against what a test needs, the regions covered, the labels, the sources of the synthetic X-rays and 3D priors, and what each removal costs); the interactive figure asks for the changes only through storage.yml, whose run opens a request pull request the owner merges.

source.notes: Drawn from a committed snapshot of OpenSpineConsortium/spine-datasets's PLAN.json on its branch storage-feed, built 2026-10-25T02:53:38Z from that repository's records, with the lab volume read 2026-10-24T17:15:28Z by the grid's status word; the snapshot's sha256 is e9d65fef56a2f178b31665f6c7b3492306038f77c73fa7cabcef67a667f65411. The sizes are the feed's own, measured where a set is frozen and stated by its source otherwise, and the home's use is null until a grid word reads it. Each set's value (people and scans, level truth read or automatic, regions, masks by level, prior source, pairing tier) and the power block are read by spine-datasets from the set's record alone (its pull request #249); the panel sums them for the sets kept after the choices, the people with level truth at most as the power block does and at least less what the overlap lists let two sets share. .github/workflows/docs.yml refreshes the snapshot with the App's read token before each site build and builds the page from the committed snapshot when the feed is unreachable; a reading is dated, never a final value, and the page shows its age.
